yt_mechanics.description:
Pendle splits a yield-bearing asset (SY = Standardized Yield token) into two tokens:
  PT (Principal Token) — redeemable 1:1 at maturity for underlying; no intermediate yield
  YT (Yield Token)     — receives ALL yield generated by underlying until maturity; expires at ZERO value at maturity

Buying YT = long the yield rate. Profit if avg realized underlying APY > implied APY paid.

key_formulas.leverage_factor: YT price is a small fraction of underlying => small APY move = large % PnL on YT
key_formulas.time_decay: YT decays to 0 linearly under constant implied yield; accelerates near maturity

example_sUSDe_Dec26.yt_profit_condition: sUSDe avg APY > 9% over holding period
example_sUSDe_Dec26.note: If sUSDe APY reverts to 5%, YT holder LOSES vs holding PT

primary_drivers.description: Pendle market participants price YT based on expectations of future underlying APY. If sentiment shifts dovish (rate compression expected), implied yield falls → YT prices drop → entry-point risk for holders
sUSDe underlying depends on ETH/BTC perpetual funding rates. Funding can flip negative in bear markets. aUSDC depends on Aave utilization. Historical sUSDe range: 1% to 55.9% (K344 research)
YT value decays to zero linearly under constant implied yield. Near maturity (< 30 days), price depreciates rapidly, reducing capital efficiency unless yield is extremely high.
Some YT markets (stUSDS, early USDe markets) trade at 2-3x implied APY due to airdrop points farming. Premium collapses post-airdrop.
Thin YT pools cause significant slippage at $100K+ ticket sizes.

apy_summary.note: SC risk premium 2pp vs K471's 0.2pp/protocol because Pendle YT is STACKED risk: Pendle contract + underlying protocol + YT time-decay mechanics. Conservative: 1pp Pendle + 0.5pp underlying + 0.5pp rollover gap risk = 2pp total

rollover_model.operational_risk: Rollover requires ACTIVE management: exit YT before maturity to avoid realized loss on time-decayed residual. Automation via Pendle SDK is possible but adds smart contract surface area. 'Set and forget' is NOT viable.
rollover_model.optimal_entry_timing: Best entry: 60-90 days before maturity when implied yield is highest relative to underlying. Avoid <30 days (time decay dominates). Avoid >180 days (too much uncertainty on underlying rate trajectory).

G2_audit_verified.notes: Pendle audited by Ackee, Dedaub, ChainSecurity, Least Authority; PASS

G3_yield_stability.notes: Yield std ~4.5pp (sUSDe underlying range 1-55.9%). HIGH variance. FAIL — YT amplifies underlying vol; implied yield can swing 4pp intramonth

G4_redemption_time_le_7d.notes: YT can be sold on Pendle AMM; exit ~2d (liquidity-dependent). Thin markets may require multiple days for large positions. CONDITIONAL

G5_corr_vs_k280_lt_0.4.notes: Correlation vs K280 momentum = 0.04. Stablecoin yield is near-zero corr with directional momentum. PASS

G6_sc_event_max_loss_lt_30pct.notes: At 10-15% allocation, a total wipe of Pendle position = 10-15% loss on the full yield sleeve. Tolerable. PASS at ≤15% allocation. Would FAIL at >30% allocation.

capacity_analysis.note: At $500K, Pendle YT is well within liquidity for sUSDe-Dec26. Morpho-MEV and stUSDS markets are thinner ($30-40M TVL) and SHOULD BE AVOIDED for positions > $200K.

dimensions.description: Market re-prices implied yield lower (rate expectations shift dovish). YT price drops, capital tied up until maturity. Historical: sUSDe implied yield dropped from 15% → 5% in 3 months (2024).
dimensions.mitigation: Entry at ≤90d maturities; cap allocation at 10-15%; stop-loss via YT secondary sale.

dimensions.description: sUSDe yield collapses if ETH/BTC funding turns negative (bear market). YT holder earns LESS than implied APY paid → net loss on YT position. K344 documented sUSDe APY range: 1.0% to 55.9% (std=3.5pp).
dimensions.mitigation: Prefer aUSDC-backed YT (lower vol) over sUSDe-backed for stability sleeve.

dimensions.description: Pendle core contract bug could freeze or drain YT positions. Precedent: Penpie (third-party) exploit Sep 2024 ($27M); Pendle itself paused contracts as precaution but core was NOT breached. Multiple auditors (7+ audits) reduce probability.
dimensions.mitigation: Cap at 10-15% allocation; diversify across 2+ markets; monitor Pendle bug bounty.

dimensions.description: Ethena USDe de-peg risk (funding flip + redemption spiral). TVL $16.5B in Oct 2025 → potential systemic risk if unwinding. YT value → 0 if underlying de-pegs significantly.
dimensions.mitigation: Prefer aUSDC-backed YT (Aave underlying) for maximum stability.

dimensions.description: Failure to roll over before maturity means YT expires at $0. Accumulated yield IS claimable post-maturity as SY, but the principal YT position value is lost. Requires calendar-based monitoring.
dimensions.mitigation: Automate rollover trigger at T-30 days; alert system mandatory.

dimensions.description: Large YT exits on thin pools cause significant slippage. At $500K, sUSDe-Dec26 pool is manageable (0.17% of TVL). Morpho-MEV and stUSDS markets thinner; avoid for positions >$200K.
dimensions.mitigation: TWAP exits over 2-3 days for positions >$200K; pre-screen pool depth.

dimensions.description: Pendle governance can adjust swap fees, protocol revenue split.
dimensions.mitigation: Monitor Pendle governance forum; fee changes are gradual and telegraphed.

decision.rationale: MC expected net = -0.51pp (negative). Risk-adjusted return does not exceed simpler alternatives. Spark sUSDS at 6.1% net (passive, low ops) strictly dominates Pendle YT on expected return basis after accounting for yield variance.
decision.preferred_market: YT-aUSDC (Aave V3 Dec 2026) if CONDITIONAL; avoid YT-sUSDe for yield sleeve

required_components: Pendle SDK / V2 router integration for YT buy/sell
Yield claim automation (SY claim at maturity)
Rollover execution script (exit + re-enter new market)
Implied APY monitor (exit signal if implied drops > 3pp from entry)
Gas price oracle (avoid rollover during L1 congestion)

preferred_yt_market_for_v621.rationale: aUSDC underlying has LOWEST volatility (Aave utilization is mean-reverting). Implied APY ~5.2% net; modest but predictable. Suitable for yield sleeve.
preferred_yt_market_for_v621.secondary: YT-sUSDe (Dec 2026) — higher yield but higher variance; limit 50% of Pendle sub-sleeve

operational_notes.automation_priority: Must build rollover automation BEFORE deploying capital. Manual rollover at scale is high operational risk. Estimated: 1 wave for Pendle SDK scaffold + 1 wave for live rollover test.
